papers.t: Reducing nitrogen application by 20% under the condition of multiple cropping using green manure after wheat harvesting can mitigate carbon emission without sacrificing maize yield in arid areas
No-tillage mulch with green manure retention can mitigate carbon emissions, increase crop productivity, and promote agricultural sustainability
No-tillage with total green manure mulching reduces soil respiration by regulating soil moisture affecting heterotrophic respiration
No-Tillage Treatment with Total Green Manure Mulching Reduces Soil Respiration by Regulating Soil Water Content Affecting Heterotrophic Respiration
